rationale: The compiled seed edits, bindings, and selector faithfully realize the reviewed design without introducing new defects. Route fidelity: the focal path (teams→user_teams→users→message_reactions→messages→channels→channel_members) exactly matches the seven assigned route_nodes with no extra hops, and filters (reaction_type='eyes' on the REACTION node, user_id='U_SOPHIE' on the CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP node) correctly encode the prompt's relationship: a workspace member's eyes-reaction on a message in a channel where Sophie separately holds membership. Verified matches: T01WORKSPACE (Łukasz, a T01 member per user_teams, reacts eyes on new message 1706200000.000001 in core-infra/C_INFRA, where Sophie is a channel member per channel_members) and T02NIMBUS (Dana, a T02 member, reacts eyes on her own new message in nim-research/C_NIMRESEARCH, where Sophie also holds a channel_members row) both check out against the compiled seed rows. T03GHOST correctly fails: Ivo's eyes reaction sits in ghost-ops/C_GHOSTOPS, and channel_members lists only Ivo and the agent there — no Sophie row — making it a genuine near-miss negative, matching mechanical_checks' computed_focal_negatives. All three message_reactions negatives are internally consistent with the compiled channel_members table: Mateo's thumbsup on Sophie's model-research message is excluded by wrong emoji (channel_members confirms Sophie is in C_MODEL), Nick's eyes reaction sits in 'growth' (C04MNOP3456) where channel_members lists only Nick/Gabriel/Hubert/agent — correctly excluding Sophie — and Kenji's unreacted engineering message has no reaction row and no Sophie membership in C03IJKL9012. No stray reactions exist elsewhere in message_reactions that would create unintended extra matches (e.g., the pre-existing agent/eyes reaction on the engineering message stays a non-match since Sophie isn't in that channel). The access_plan is satisfied by the compiled user_teams/channel_members inserts giving the agent membership in T01/T02/T03 workspaces and their respective core-infra/nim-research/ghost-ops channels, enabling the documented read-only APIs (users.conversations, conversations.history, reactions.get, conversations.members) without requiring unavailable fields. Answer attributes (teams.team_id, teams.team_name) are real, undisguised columns, and the identifying paths/alternative sufficient sets are consistent with the route and binding_note without smuggling in unrequested conditions. Mechanical checks report no errors and computed_matches/computed_focal_negatives align exactly with the intended design. The case is a clean, well-motivated multi-match read-only lookup with properly differentiated negatives and no answer leakage.
